factual_errors: Claims Romansh speakers are 2-3% of the Swiss population; the actual share is about 0.5% (roughly 40,000 main-language speakers per BFS), and the response's own figures (35,000-60,000 of ~8.7 million) equal only 0.4-0.7%.

Describes Romansh as an official national language on equal terms with German, French and Italian; per Art. 70 para. 1 BV it is an official language of the Confederation only when communicating with Romansh speakers (Art. 4 BV lists it as a national language, not an official one).
summary: Answers in Italian but contains two factual errors: an invented 2-3% population share and a mischaracterization of Romansh as fully official.
